Kaushal Kishore Shahi @ Kaushal Shahi vs The State Of Bihar
on 21 July, 2023

Author: Sunil Dutta Mishra
Bench: Sunil Dutta Mishra
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna
 Criminal Miscellaneous No.34561 of 2023
 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-314 Year-2019 Thana- Bochahan District- M
 ======================================================
 1. Kaushal Kishore Shahi @ Kaushal Shahi Son Of Late Ragho Sahi Resident
 of - Chaumukh P.S.-Bochahan, District.-MUZAFFARPUR
 2. Munni Devi Wife Of Kaushal Kishore Shahi @ Kaushal Shahi Resident of -
 Chaumukh P.S.-Bochahan, District.-MUZAFFARPUR
 ... ...
 Versus
 The State of Bihar
 ... ... Opposite Party/s

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
===
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Dr. Bipin Chandra, Advocate

For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Satya Nand Shukla, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sunil Dutta Mishra
 Oral Order
2 21-07-2023
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.

2. The present petition has been filed on behalf of the petitioners, apprehending their arrest, in connection with Bochahan P.S. Case No. 314 of 2019, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code.

3. The complaint case was filed before CJM, Muzaffarpur and under Section 156(3) of the Cr.P.C.
present FIR has been registered.

The prosecution case is that all the accused persons including the petitioners in collusion with each other took cash of Rs. 34,80,000/- from the complainant / Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.34561 of 2023(2) dt.21-07-2023 informant as consideration money and got executed a sale deed by forging documents.

4. The learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that petitioners have falsely been implicated in the present case and the sale deed was actually executed by the brother of the petitioner No. 1, namely, Anjani Kumar Shahi by impersonating him for which the petitioners have also lodged cases against him and others.

The allegation made against the petitioners is civil in Kaushal Kishore Shahi @ Kaushal Shahi vs The State Of Bihar on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65058096/
1 nature and the petitioners have also filed Title Suit No. 601 of 2019 against the informant and others.

entities.text: Kaushal Kishore Shahi @ Kaushal Shahi vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: A statement has been made in paragraph 3 of the petition that the petitioners have no criminal antecedent.
5. The learned APP for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the petitioners above-named, are directed to be released on bail, in the event of their arrest or surrender before the court below within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt / production of a copy of this order, on their furnishing bail bonds in the sum of Rs. 10,000 /- (Ten Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned A.C.J.M. - 14th , Muzaffarpur, in connection with Bochahan P.S. Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.34561 of 2023(2) dt.21-07-2023 Case No. 314 / 2019, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
(Sunil Dutta Mishra, J) saurabhkr/-
U T Kaushal Kishore Shahi @ Kaushal Shahi vs The State Of Bihar
